claims.text: The hotel is about 700 meters from the center of Amalfi, in the direction of Positano.

findings.quote: From Amalfi proceed in the direction of Positano and some 700 meters from the center of Amalfi you

claims.text: The hotel is built into the cliffside, surrounded by Mediterranean gardens and a series of terraces leading down to beach level.

findings.quote: is built into the cliffside surrounded by Mediterranean gardens and a series of terraces leading down to beach level

claims.text: The hotel offers a free shuttle service to and from the port and center of Amalfi every day of the week.

findings.quote: The hotel offers a free shuttle service to and from the port and center of Amalfi every day of the week.

claims.text: Guests can book a private boat transfer directly to the hotel's jetty from Naples and other towns along the Amalfi Coast.

findings.quote: Guests can book a private boat transfer directly to the hotel

claims.text: Rooms and suites have hand painted majolica floors, marble bathrooms and balconies with sea and garden views.

findings.quote: all the rooms and suites at Hotel Santa Caterina are spacious and bright, with hand painted majolica floors, marble bathrooms and balconies with wonderful sea and garden views

claims.text: Glicine restaurant serves modern interpretations of classic Amalfi cuisine.

findings.quote: Modern interpretations of classic Amalfi cuisine ensure Glicine is deservedly well-placed

claims.text: At the beach club, guests can have a cocktail at the Beach Bar and a Mediterranean style lunch at Al Mare Restaurant.

findings.quote: Between a cocktail at the Beach Bar and a Mediterranean style lunch at Al Mare Restaurant

claims.text: La Terrazza offers cocktails, bites and snacks throughout the day.

findings.quote: Throughout the day, La Terrazza offers a selection of cocktails, bites, and snacks.

claims.text: Giusi and Ninni Gambardella, with their children Crescenzo Gargano and Alessandro and Beatrice Camera, directly manage the hotel's day-to-day operations.

findings.quote: Giusi and Ninni Gambardella, assisted by their children Crescenzo Gargano and Alessandro and Beatrice Camera, directly manage the day-to- day operations of the hotel

claims.text: The gym has Technogym equipment and windows with views of the sea.

findings.quote: A gym with Technogym equipment and windows with views of the sea completes the experience.

claims.text: Bath amenities are from Bvlgari's white tea collection.

findings.quote: All the bath amenities are from Bvlgari’s white tea collection

claims.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of The World.

findings.quote: Santa Caterina, a member of The Leading Hotels of The World

claims.text: An elevator descends along the cliff, with a window looking out over the panoramic view.

findings.quote: The elevator takes you down rather than up, descending along the cliff while you take in the panoramic view through its window

claims.text: The Romeo e Giulietta suite is a two-story villa on the cliff above the sea, with a terrace that has a heated infinity pool and solarium.

findings.quote: Perhaps the most special suite is the Romeo e Giulietta, an intimate two-story villa perched high on the cliff above the sea with a terrace equipped with a heated infinity pool and solarium.

claims.text: The beach club has easy access to the sea and a salt water swimming pool, with sun beds, umbrellas, beach towels, and changing and shower areas.

findings.quote: With easy access to the sea and a salt water swimming pool, the beach club service includes sun beds, umbrellas, beach towels, changing and shower areas

claims.text: The hotel received its first guests in 1904, after Dr. Giuseppe Gambardella and his family turned their house into a small inn.

findings.quote: It received its first guests in 1904 after Dr. Giuseppe Gambardella and his family decided to transform their house into a small inn with only six guestrooms.

claims.text: Casa Marchesa is a historic residence surrounded by Sfusato Amalfitano lemon groves, with a view of the Mediterranean Sea.

findings.quote: this historic residence has a breathtaking view of the Mediterranean Sea and is surrounded by fragrant Sfusato Amalfitano lemon groves

claims.text: The beach club is open from mid-April to October.
The beach club deck, including the pool, is not fully accessible, but access is possible with the assistance of staff.

findings.quote: The deck is not fully accessible (including the pool), however access is made possible with the assistance of our staff.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive location.
